+++ b/src/click/chain_value_error.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Command
+from .core import Group
+
+
+def chain_value_error(
+    base_command: Group, cmd_name: str, cmd: Command, register: bool = False
+) -> None:
+    """Validate that ``cmd`` may be nested under ``base_command``.
+
+    Behaves like the check used by :class:`Group` for chained groups, but
+    raises :exc:`ValueError` instead of :exc:`RuntimeError`.
+
+    :param base_command: The group the command is added to or found in.
+    :param cmd_name: The name of the subcommand.
+    :param cmd: The subcommand being checked.
+    :param register: Whether the command is being registered rather than
+        resolved, which changes the error message.
+    :raises ValueError: If ``base_command`` is in chain mode and ``cmd`` is
+        a group.
+    """
+    if not base_command.chain or not isinstance(cmd, Group):
+        return
+
+    if register:
+        message = (
+            f"It is not possible to add the group {cmd_name!r} to another"
+            f" group {base_command.name!r} that is in chain mode."
+        )
+    else:
+        message = (
+            f"Found the group {cmd_name!r} as subcommand to another group "
+            f" {base_command.name!r} that is in chain mode. This is not supported."
+        )
+
+    raise ValueError(message)
diff --git a/tests/test_chain_value_error.py b/tests/test_chain_value_error.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5c474e9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_chain_value_error.py
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.chain_value_error import chain_value_error
+
+
+def test_non_chain_group_allows_nested_group():
+    assert chain_value_error(click.Group("a"), "b", click.Group("b")) is None
+
+
+def test_chain_group_allows_command():
+    base = click.Group("a", chain=True)
+    assert chain_value_error(base, "b", click.Command("b")) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("register", "match"),
+    [(True, "It is not possible to add the group"), (False, "Found the group")],
+)
+def test_chain_group_rejects_nested_group(register, match):
+    base = click.Group("a", chain=True)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=match):
+        chain_value_error(base, "b", click.Group("b"), register=register)
